text_block_list.text:
A year of continuously "communicating" 
while groping in the dark came to an end. 
And then, Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe gets a "passing 
mark."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean I can race again next year? 
That I can keep spreading our 
"connections"?

Having experienced numerous races, she 
built up a solid career to carry into next 
year.

Our activities are going swimmingly. 
However—

Inorganic eyes. Whenever I try to bring up 
that "future prediction" topic, Neo 
Universe's eyes lose their color.

Almost as if—her consciousness had flown 
off somewhere. Those eyes were...
Held a spine-chilling abyss within.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you are...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Whether you... are truly "you" is an 
"unknown," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Is "PREV" continuous, or discontinuous? 
Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer—come.

"Following the pull of the invitation, I 
trailed behind Neo Universe. It felt as 
though a single, cold door had opened."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I "captured" a few. Among them...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I wish to share the 'maximum coordinates' 
with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "GATE" that Neo Universe must surpass.

"Gate"... An English word whose meaning I 
actually understand for once.

If it literally means "Gate", then that 
must be what she talked about before her 
debut...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Connect," and then... "ANOI." —One more.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe has something she wants to 
'accomplish.'"

Crossing that gate might just be Neo 
Universe's other hidden purpose.

A goal just as important as 'connecting 
with other Umamusume.' That was...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's a certain race, you see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wants to enter that race――and 
move forward.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: From now... in about 500 Earth days...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The year after next," right. The race 
name is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Tenno Sho (Spring).
choice_data_list: So it's the spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.text:
The name of the race was familiar. A 
Senior-class long-distance GⅠ that 
everyone dreams of winning. But...

"What I don't understand is the connection 
to Neo Universe. Why the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)?"

Could that also be an answer calculated by 
that "future prediction" of hers?

Yet I was too afraid to ask any further. A 
single cold door that had finally 
opened...

Just having her share her goal was huge 
progress. I decided not to pry further and 
wait for the day she opens up on her own.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, our "course" is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To "approach" the Tenno Sho (Spring)... 
where is Neo Universe heading?

—A distant goal. It is far too early to 
start tuning for the 3,200m distance. In 
that case...
choice_data_list: I think the Satsuki Sho is a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho. —1.242742 miles.

The first race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, 2000m. Stepping quite normally onto 
the trajectory everyone aims for, and 
then—

From the 3000m 'Kikuka Sho' in the fall to 
the 3200m 'Tenno Sho (Spring)'. That path 
seemed like the royal road.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "orbit" that many stars traverse... 
That route is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Premised on "piggyback"—right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Calculations complete. We can reach the 
stratosphere.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Whether they can achieve a breakthrough, 
though...

"Neo Universe still seemed hesitant, but I 
barely managed to convince her."

Next year, starting from the Satsuki Sho, 
let's gradually probe into Neo Universe's 
true intentions.
